_comment: License policy for cartesi/rollups-ts. Enforced by `pnpm lint:licenses` (= `node scripts/audit-licenses.mjs --check`) and in CI by .github/workflows/license-check.yaml. Every entry under `exceptions` carries its own `evidence` URL and the gate rejects an exception missing one, so the justification for each is in this file — there is no separate document to go and find.
_allowBuildOnly: Permitted in dev/build and in the private docs app, but NOT inside the runtime closure of a published @cartesi/* package. MPL-2.0 is weak copyleft: unmodified use as a build tool is fine, shipping it in a library is a different conversation. LicenseRef-Sustainable-Use-1.0 is here for a different reason — it is not open source at all, it restricts use to non-commercial or internal purposes and forbids distributing the software for a fee. It reaches us only through apps/docs (vocs -> @codesandbox/sandpack-react -> sandpack-client -> nodebox), which is private:true and never published to npm. Listing it here rather than on the allowlist is deliberate: the moment it turns up in a published package's runtime closure the gate fails with a scope violation instead of waving it through.
_allowWithNotice: Allowed anywhere, but the attribution has to appear on the docs third-party notices page. The gate lists these on every run so the page cannot silently fall behind.
_deny: Always fails, in any scope, even inside a larger OR expression that would otherwise pass.
_exceptions: Coordinates whose published metadata cannot be resolved to an SPDX id. Every entry must carry BOTH a hand-resolved `license` and an `evidence` URL — the gate rejects an exception missing either, so nobody can wave a package through without recording what they read.

khroma@2.1.0.note: No license field in the published manifest. Upstream repo carries the MIT text.

spawndamnit@3.0.1.note: Publishes 'SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE'. The referenced file is plain MIT.

@codesandbox/nodebox@0.1.8.note: Publishes 'SEE LICENSE IN ./LICENSE'. The referenced file is the Sustainable Use License v1.0 — source-available, NOT open source: use is limited to internal business, non-commercial or personal purposes, and redistribution is only permitted free of charge for non-commercial purposes. The upstream text is byte-identical to the LICENSE shipped in the 0.1.8 tarball. Resolved to a LicenseRef because there is no SPDX id for it, and listed under allowBuildOnly so it stays confined to apps/docs; see _allowBuildOnly.

_publishable: Packaging rules for every non-private package under packages/. These encode audit findings F2 and F3 so they cannot regress once fixed.
_publishableTemporary: requireLicenseField and requireLicenseInFiles are OFF on purpose, and only until issue #2 lands. They encode audit findings F2/F3 — five packages declare no "license" field and seven do not ship their LICENSE — which is packaging work tracked in that issue. Turning them on here would hold the dependency-side rules hostage to a packaging fix, so they start off and the PR that fixes the manifests flips BOTH back to true. If you are reading this after issue #2 closed, that PR forgot to flip them.
_elections: Recorded choice for dual-licensed dependencies, for the notices page. Not enforced by the gate — both arms are on the allowlist — but written down so the choice is not re-litigated.
